website_records.title: Winter 2027 Psychology PSYC 099/199 Common Application
website_records.description: Common application for matching students to psychology labs. PSYC 099 and 199 enrollment criteria are alternative branches.

eligibility.raw_text: Prerequisites for PSYC-099: Lower division standing, completion of at least 30 units of undergraduate studies at UCSD with a minimum UCSD GPA of 3.0; completed and approvedTriton Enrollment Authorization (TEA) request. May be taken for P/NP credit three times.

Prerequisites for PSYC-199: Upper-division standing, completion of at least 90 units of undergraduate studies at UCSD with a minimum UCSD GPA of 2.5; completed and approved Triton Enrollment Authorization (TEA) request. May be taken for P/NP credit nine times.
Please note: Students who do not meet these minimum University requirements for booking may obtain additional approval from their college.

website_records.deadline_text: The Winter 2027 PSYC-099/199 Common Application is now live. The deadline to complete the Winter 2027 PSYC-099/199 Common Application is midnight on Friday, November 20, 2026.
website_records.application_method: Fill out the PSYC 099/199 Common Application or contact individual labs.

compensation.quote: You may earn either 2 units (60 hours/quarter) or 4 units (120 hours/quarter) each quarter.

website_records.title: Faculty Mentor Program (FMP)
website_records.description: A two-quarter program that pairs undergraduate students with UC San Diego faculty mentors to conduct research, develop research skills, and explore post-graduate career paths through workshops and seminars. Students receive independent study course credit and present at a poster symposium.

eligibility.raw_text: Have a minimum GPA of 2.7 at the beginning of the program (Winter Quarter).
Have sophomore standing (45 completed units) or above by the time the program begins.
Be able to commit at least 12 hours a week to research-related and professional development activities each quarter of participation.
Be able to commit to both consecutive quarters of the program (Winter and Spring).
Enroll in a 99 or 199 independent study course for each quarter of participation in the program.

website_records.application_method: Apply via the Undergraduate Research Hub Application Portal

compensation.quote: Academic credit: Get 4 units of 99 or 199 Independent Study credit for each quarter you participate in FMP.

international.quote: International, undocumented, visiting, and transfer students are all eligible as long as they fulfill the above requirements.
